$comment: Provenance: bundled SPICE model library index for circsim, MIT. Every model file referenced here carries its own 'Provenance:' header and was written in-house from datasheet parameters (no vendor model text). PinMap node positions are 1-based and refer to the device's terminal order: diode/LED = 'anode cathode' (1=anode, 2=cathode); BJT = 'collector base emitter' (1=C, 2=B, 3=E); VDMOS = 'drain gate source' (1=D, 2=G, 3=S). Pad numbers come from the KiCad footprint. Diode footprints follow the KiCad convention pad-1 = cathode.

entries.$comment: SOP-8 power NMOS: pads 1-3=S, 4=G, 5-8=D. The deck generator emits ONE node per pinMap entry, so exactly one representative pad per VDMOS terminal is mapped (5=D, 4=G, 1=S) — mapping two pads to one terminal position would emit extra nodes. MPN/value matching only (a Q + SOP-8 fallback would collide with mosfet-nce6005as and false-positive on unknown SOP-8 parts).
entries.provenance: Written for circsim from NCE4012S datasheet parameters (Vgs(th) typ 2.2V, Rds(on)~18mohm@4.5V, Ciss~1.7nF, Crss~160pF), VDMOS NMOS, MIT.

entries.$comment: Dual 60V/5A NMOS in SOP-8 (1=S1 2=G1 3=S2 4=G2 5,6=D2 7,8=D1): subckt terminals d1 g1 s1 d2 g2 s2, two VDMOS devices; the .model card lives inside the subckt so deck inlining carries it. One representative pad per terminal (7=D1, 5=D2). MPN/value matching only.

entries.$comment: Quad open-collector comparator — same behavioral cell as comparator-lm393 (subckt order inp inn out vcc vee). Unit 1 on a SOP/SOIC/TSSOP/DIP-14: 5(IN1+)/4(IN1-)/2(OUT1, open-collector), 3=VCC, 12=GND. Units 2-4 unmapped (same convention as the opamp-lm324 quad). External pull-up required. MPN/value matching only — a refdes/footprint fallback would silently claim any unknown 14-pin U part (e.g. a CD4011 in SOP-14). pinMaps keys are for pin mapping, not matching.
entries.provenance: Behavioral comparator written for circsim from LM339/LM2901 datasheet (open-collector output, response time ~1.3us) — reuses the LM393 cell in opamp.lib, MIT.
